fichas.title: Noise control glazing
fichas.summary: Insulated glazing can provide noise control when supplemented with measures such as heavier or resin-filled panes, noise-reduction foil, and panes of differing thicknesses. These measures may affect visual transmittance, g-value and Ug-value. Sound reduction values and spectrum adaptation terms should be checked against manufacturer data, and products should have the required test certificates.

fichas.title: Security glazing
fichas.summary: Security glazing includes break-in-resistant glazing for private areas, multilayer glazing for resistance to manual attack, bullet-proof glass, and glazing tested for explosion resistance. Requirements and resistance classes depend on the application and applicable standards; VdS certification is required for the indicated classes. Explosion-resistance testing described here used glazing fixed all round in a retaining construction.
